title: Refund amount not validated against captured total
explanation: refund() returns { refunded: amount } for any amount without comparing it to order.captured. That lets callers credit more than was captured (or any unchecked value), corrupting money state.
failureScenario: order = { captured: 100 }, amount = 500 → returns { refunded: 500 } and over-refunds by 400.

fix.summary: Reject refunds that exceed the captured amount before returning.
